answer.answer: The archive holds two reported revenue figures for AAPL for the period 2006-10-01 to 2007-09-29, and ST-EVA has not selected one. Both are SOURCE_REPORTED, both use the same source concept (us-gaap:SalesRevenueNet, mapped to the revenue metric as PARTIAL, i.e. a component rather than an exact expression of the metric), both come from the same provider (SecEdgar, regulatory filings), and both are UNVERIFIABLE because a single official source cannot cross-validate itself. The first is USD 24,006,000,000 as filed in 10-K accession 0001193125-09-214859 (available from 2009-10-27). The second is USD 24,578,000,000 as filed in 10-K/A accession 0001193125-10-012091 (available from 2010-01-25). ST-EVA records this as an ambiguity with reason MULTIPLE_FILINGS and resolution NO_WINNER_SELECTED: the same source concept is reported with two different values by two filings, which may be a restatement, a re-filing, or two different periods of coverage, and the evidence held does not establish which filing a question was about. The two values differ by USD 572,000,000. I am not choosing between them.
uncertainties: Which of USD 24,006,000,000 (10-K) and USD 24,578,000,000 (10-K/A) is correct for the period ending 2007-09-29 is not settled; the evidence states neither a winner nor a reason for the difference.
Both figures are UNVERIFIABLE: no cross-check was recorded against any other source (validation records are empty for both observations).
The mapping from us-gaap:SalesRevenueNet to the revenue metric is PARTIAL, so neither value is an exact expression of the metric; a series break is recorded at this period.

No other concept (e.g. us-gaap:Revenues) is held for this period; a wider search across 2006-06-01 to 2008-06-30 returned only these two observations for this period end, plus later periods 2007-09-30 to 2008-06-28 and 2008-03-30 to 2008-06-28.
